propositions: Fourteen call sites in src/rebar/llm hand-build identical single-turn structured request shapes with mode='structured', execution_mode='single_turn', and output_schema, violating DRY principle and risking inconsistency.

RunRequest contract requires single_turn requests to carry both mode='structured' and output_schema to stay consistent, but enforcement is invisible and re-asserted by hand at each call site rather than validated once.

Bounding decisions (output_token_limit, structured_retry_limit, transport_attempt_limit, request_timeout_limit_s) are declared explicitly at only two sites; omission at others is silent and indistinguishable from deliberate unboundedness, creating bugs like leathery-druidic-nurseshark.
A shared constructor RunRequest.for_structured with required bounds argument will make the bounding decision mandatory and visible, replacing copy-paste with a single greppable token per site.

The oracle test _run_request_sites in test_subcall_class_selection.py must be extended to recognize RunRequest.for_structured in addition to direct RunRequest(...) calls, keeping the frozen 24-entry site table assertion unchanged.

Guard mechanism will prevent raw RunRequest construction carrying both execution_mode='single_turn' and mode='structured' except in runner.py or with reasoned # single-turn-structured-ok: marker escape.
